title: RF Guard Entry Contract
description: Phase 2 SSOT contract for one row of guards-map.json. One entry = one responsibility in one layer.

layer.description: Architectural layer. guard=1 responsibility, checker=1 rule, runner=orchestration only, map=data only, cli=I/O only.

rule.description: Single-responsibility statement. Exactly one rule — no ' and ' joining two distinct rules.

ruleReviewed.description: false = rule text auto-derived from filename, pending human confirmation in a later phase. Honest evidence flag (no fake-green).

pathCurrent.description: Existing path on disk for state=existing; null only for state=planned.

owner.description: Accountable owner. No entry without an owner.

test.description: Path to the 1:1 architecture contract test, or null if not yet written.

blocking.description: Phase 2 invariant: every entry MUST be non-blocking.

scope.description: What files/dirs the guard inspects. Set when reviewed or planned.

pathPlanned.description: Target path for state=planned guards not yet on disk.

reviewNote.description: Reviewer finding (e.g. why it can't be single-rule yet).

recommendation.description: Outcome of rule review. 'clean' = already 1 rule; 'split' = multiple rules; 'reclassify' = wrong layer.
